clearcuts.note: Recorded radar detections, not verified event extents. Cause labels are hypotheses; confidence is a heuristic rule score, not a calibrated cause probability. first_flagged_acquisition is an observation date, not a confirmed event date. Agreement labels summarize block majorities: L/C does not mean the other radar detected nothing; both includes shared majorities or split patches. Raw rule evidence is retained. Band changes and intervals are the saved evidence values in dB. CSV only; notebook and GeoTIFF are unavailable for these saved results. No scientific rerun.
